scope.description: Windows endpoint selection, capture, monitoring, recording, low-latency modes, and hardware qualification; excludes third-party plug-in hosting and whole-DAW readiness.
scope.change_reason: Initial frozen audio scope from T012. Weights: core workflow 3, common requirement 2, qualification/polish 1 or 3 according to workflow criticality.

t012-source-review.identity: exe SHA-256 50632E097BE3518FF49379575B40FA4C87EED2A549AADA414DE3DAC16C36FB13; source hashes for app.rs, project_file.rs, wasapi_backend.rs, recording.rs, lib.rs are recorded in tasks/T012-wasapi-low-latency.md

t012-user-intent.note: User's target-device, shared-audio, optional-exclusive, low-latency and track-routing requirements; not runtime evidence.

requirements.outcome: Capture and render endpoints are selectable independently by stable ID, and endpoint enumeration failures are visible.
requirements.implementation_note: Endpoint selection and enumeration diagnostics exist in source; Onyx discovery on this PC is not verified.

requirements.outcome: An input-test session runs independently of Record and shows distinct capture-channel meters.
requirements.implementation_note: The Windows input probe is independent of recording and can meter up to 64 channels; physical signal is unverified.

requirements.outcome: Windows offers shared low-latency, visible shared-compatible fallback, and explicit opt-in exclusive stream modes.
requirements.implementation_note: The WASAPI paths are implemented; actual supported periods and endpoint behavior are not measured.

requirements.outcome: A monitored track selects a physical input channel and sends it through that track's processing and output route.
requirements.implementation_note: Stereo/Left/Right capture and Stereo/Left/Right/Disconnected output routes exist, but there is no general typed bus matrix or arbitrary endpoint channel mapping.

requirements.outcome: Armed tracks record their selected input channel to separate synchronized WAV takes through a bounded writer path.
requirements.implementation_note: Per-track stereo/left/right routes and separate files are present; synchronization and isolation need two-input hardware review.

requirements.outcome: Failed device changes preserve valid streams, explain causes, and recover after endpoint loss or reclaim.
requirements.implementation_note: Explicit release/reopen and generic stream errors exist. Atomic capture+render rollback, endpoint hot-plug notifications, and a complete actionable error taxonomy are not implemented.

requirements.outcome: Onyx shared/exclusive behavior, round-trip latency, other-app coexistence, and sustained stability are measured and reported.
requirements.implementation_note: This is a hardware qualification gate and has not been run.

onyx-inputs.description: Onyx inputs 1 and 2 appear and produce independent meters.

shared-coexistence.description: Monitoring/recording and browser/game audio work together in shared mode.

track-routing.description: Track processing and selected input/output routes produce isolated expected signals.

exclusive-recovery.description: Exclusive access and release behave as selected, with safe return to shared mode.

latency-and-endurance.description: Physical round-trip latency and sustained stability are measured on the target device.
